In The High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 Crr 215 of 2026

+
 IA NO:CRAN/1/2026  (not in the file)
 Bapi Mandal & Ors.
 Vs.
 State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Sabir Ahmed, Adv.,
 Mr. Tasnim Ahamed, Adv.
 ...

It is submitted by both the learned advocates for the respective parties that there has been an amicable settlement between the parties and to that extent, a joint compromise application has been filed which is pending before this Court.
The application is not in the file.
The department is directed to tag the said application being CRAN 1 of 2026 with this file.

2. This revisional application has been filed for quashing of the proceedings pending before the learned trial court on the basis of a complaint lodged by the opposite party no.2 under Sections 498A/325/307/427/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Since a compromise application has been effected, the learned prosecution is directed to enquire into the matter and submit a report on the next date.

3. Let the matter appear in the list on March 06, 2026 under the heading "For Orders".
4.

Petitioners are directed to serve a copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court upon the State along with a copy of the revisional application and a copy of the compromise application forthwith.

5. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of Bapi Mandal & Ors vs State Of West Bengal & Anr on 26 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171693706/
